source: DHS 2024 direct state estimates (data/public/aggregates/dhs2024_state.csv), sex = all, breakdown = all
note: Fay-Herriot failed its pre-declared diagnostics (docs/verification.md D56); every result here uses the direct estimates. No spatial method is run on JONAPWD (D17).

moran.precision_note: Noisy state estimates add independent error, which biases Moran's I towards 0; results for measures with many review-flagged states are conservative.

results.sentence: Disability among adults 18+ shows no clear geographic clustering across Nigeria's states (Moran's I = 0.13, permutation p = 0.071; adjusted p = 0.105 across 8 tests). All 37 state estimates are flagged reliable.

Difficulty seeing among adults 18+ shows no clear geographic clustering across Nigeria's states (Moran's I = 0.03, permutation p = 0.220; adjusted p = 0.251 across 8 tests). 4 of the 37 state estimates are flagged for review (few events), which pulls I towards 0, so a weak result is not evidence of no pattern.

Difficulty hearing among adults 18+ shows no clear geographic clustering across Nigeria's states (Moran's I = 0.20, permutation p = 0.025; adjusted p = 0.067 across 8 tests). The uncorrected p-value is below 0.05, but not after correcting for multiple tests. 21 of the 37 state estimates are flagged for review (few events), which pulls I towards 0, so a weak result is not evidence of no pattern.

Difficulty walking or climbing steps among adults 18+ shows no clear geographic clustering across Nigeria's states (Moran's I = 0.20, permutation p = 0.020; adjusted p = 0.067 across 8 tests). The uncorrected p-value is below 0.05, but not after correcting for multiple tests. 2 of the 37 state estimates are flagged for review (few events), which pulls I towards 0, so a weak result is not evidence of no pattern.

Difficulty remembering or concentrating among adults 18+ shows no clear geographic clustering across Nigeria's states (Moran's I = 0.14, permutation p = 0.041; adjusted p = 0.082 across 8 tests). The uncorrected p-value is below 0.05, but not after correcting for multiple tests. 25 of the 37 state estimates are flagged for review (few events), which pulls I towards 0, so a weak result is not evidence of no pattern.

Difficulty with self-care among adults 18+ shows no clear geographic clustering across Nigeria's states (Moran's I = 0.10, permutation p = 0.079; adjusted p = 0.105 across 8 tests). 20 of the 37 state estimates are flagged for review (few events), which pulls I towards 0, so a weak result is not evidence of no pattern.

Difficulty communicating among adults 18+ shows no clear geographic clustering across Nigeria's states (Moran's I = 0.27, permutation p = 0.009; adjusted p = 0.067 across 8 tests). The uncorrected p-value is below 0.05, but not after correcting for multiple tests. 28 of the 37 state estimates are flagged for review (few events), which pulls I towards 0, so a weak result is not evidence of no pattern.

Disability among children 5-17 (secondary analysis) shows no clear geographic clustering across Nigeria's states (Moran's I = -0.02, permutation p = 0.362; adjusted p = 0.362 across 8 tests). 23 of the 37 state estimates are flagged for review (few events), which pulls I towards 0, so a weak result is not evidence of no pattern.

lisa.sentence: Exploratory: no state is a significant local hotspot or coldspot of disability among adults 18+ after correcting for 37 tests (false discovery rate 0.05).

clusters.method: Ward.D2 on Euclidean distance of standardised 18+ domain prevalences
clusters.sentence: Descriptive only: grouping states by their six-domain disability profile (adults 18+) gives 2 groups (Ward clustering, best mean silhouette 0.56 of k = 2-6): group 1 (7 states: NG-AB, NG-AD, NG-BE, NG-EN, NG-IM, NG-KN, NG-TA) is above the state average in 6 of 6 domains; group 2 (30 states: NG-AK, NG-AN, NG-BA, NG-BO, NG-BY, NG-CR, NG-DE, NG-EB, NG-ED, NG-EK, NG-FC, NG-GO, NG-JI, NG-KD, NG-KE, NG-KO, NG-KT, NG-KW, NG-LA, NG-NA, NG-NI, NG-OG, NG-ON, NG-OS, NG-OY, NG-PL, NG-RI, NG-SO, NG-YO, NG-ZA) is above the state average in 0 of 6 domains. Many single-domain estimates are flagged for review, so the groups are rough and carry no inference.

services.supply: GRID3 NGA - Health Facilities v2.0, all facilities per 100,000 people (NBS 2023 population)
caveats: Ecological association between state averages: no causal claim and no inference about individuals.
General health facilities are not disability services; the count says nothing about rehabilitation, assistive technology or accessibility.
GRID3 v2.0 is non-exhaustive and not validated by government; private facilities in particular may be under-counted.
services.sentence: Ecological and descriptive: across the 37 states, health facilities per 100,000 people and adult disability prevalence have a Spearman correlation of 0.29 (permutation p = 0.078). This compares state averages only; it says nothing about individuals or causes, and general health facilities are not disability services.
